h1: Press brakes — CNC hydraulic, hybrid and electric, 22 to 1,323 US tons
intro: A press brake bends sheet and plate between a punch and a V-die; the control sets the back gauge, the ram depth and the angle, and the operator loads the sheet and presses the pedal. NovoTech sells three lines of press brakes in Canada, each on its own page: the Dener CNC press brakes — the premium line, made in Turkey, hydraulic XL to 661 US tons and 20 ft, the XH hybrid and the DDM servo-electric; NovoTech's own value-line CNC press brakes — hydraulic 55 to 331 tons and heavy-duty to 1,323 tons, electric servo brakes 3 to 176 tons and NC torsion-bar brakes from 33 tons, built in China to our specification; and the İşitan compact hydraulic press brakes, 33 to 66 tons over 4 to 7 ft for the sheet-metal shop. Below, each line in brief and the whole range in one table; every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, European-style tooling, a 1-year warranty and installation, training and parts from Mississauga, ON.
hero_points: Dener premium line: XL hydraulic 66 – 661 tons × 5 – 20 ft, XH hybrid, DDM servo-electric 44 – 220 tons, DDS from 22 tons
NovoTech value line: hydraulic CNC 55 – 1,323 tons, electric 3 – 176 tons, NC 33 – 441 tons — Delem, Hawe, Estun
İşitan compact: 33 – 66 tons × 4.2 – 6.9 ft, NC or CNC with Cybelec — plus Eurostamp tooling stocked in Canada
hero_brand_line: Dener Makina builds the premium line in Kayseri, Turkey; the NovoTech value line is built in China to our specification; İşitan builds the compact brakes in Bursa, Turkey. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.

faq.q: Dener, NovoTech value line or İşitan — which press brake should I buy?
faq.a: By the work. For plate and production — 3/8″ and 1/2″ over 10 to 20 ft, two shifts, a long options list — the Dener XL and XH are the machines; they are built in Turkey on the heaviest frame, with ESA or Delem controls and Dener Canada parts in Mississauga. The NovoTech value line is the same architecture — monoblock frame, Hawe servo valves, linear scales, Delem control — built in China to our specification at about two-thirds of the price: the right buy for a job shop that needs a 100 – 300 ton CNC brake, an electric brake for sheet, or an NC brake for repeat parts. The İşitan Edgebenders are the compact 33 – 66 ton machines for HVAC, enclosures and brackets where a 100-ton brake is more than you need. All three are installed and supported by the same NovoTech technicians.

Hydraulic gives the lowest price per ton and full force over the whole stroke — the machine for thick plate. A hybrid (Dener XH) is a hydraulic brake with a servo-driven pump: 42 – 58 % less energy, faster, quieter, for a shop that runs the brake all day. An electric brake (Dener DDM, NovoTech WADG) has no oil at all: ±0.01 mm repeatability, bending speeds to 30 mm/s and about 70 % less power — usually the better buy for 16 ga to 1/4″ sheet. Above about 150 tons and on 3/8″ plate, hydraulic still wins.

faq.q: How much tonnage and length do I need?
faq.a: Air bending mild steel with the standard V = 8 × thickness die takes roughly 8 US tons per foot for 16 ga, 15 for 1/8″, 30 for 3/16″, 55 for 1/4″ and 130 tons per foot for 1/2″; stainless needs about 50 % more, aluminum about half. Add a foot of length to the longest part you bend. A 10 ft × 1/4″ shop is a 110 – 175 ton machine; 10 ft × 3/8″ a 220 – 250 ton machine; 13 ft × 1/2″ a 400 ton machine. Tell us your thickest and longest bend and we size the brake and the tooling.

An NC brake positions the back gauge and the ram depth from a stored program, with the two cylinders kept in step by a torsion bar — rigid, cheap to maintain, right for the same parts in one material every day. A CNC brake measures the ram on linear scales and corrects it through servo valves, calculates the bend from the drawing, crowns the bed and changes material in the program — the machine for mixed work, tight angles and multi-bend parts. NovoTech's value line has both; Dener and İşitan CNC brakes come with 2D or 3D graphic controls.

faq.q: What tooling fits, and do you stock it?
faq.a: European-style (Promecam / Amada) segmented punches and dies with quick-release clamping are standard on every line, and a sectioned punch set with a 2-V die ships with each machine. NovoTech stocks Eurostamp press brake tooling in Canada — punches, dies, radius, hemming and joggle tools, gooseneck and special profiles — and sizes it to your machine; Wila hydraulic clamping and American-style adapters are options.

faq.q: What about safety and the Ontario pre-start review?
faq.a: Side guards, an enclosed rear guard, interlocked doors and an anti-panic foot pedal with emergency stop are standard; DSP or Fiessler laser finger protection and light curtains are options we recommend for every CNC machine. In Ontario a new press brake needs a pre-start health and safety review (PSR) under Regulation 851 before it runs; NovoTech prepares the documentation for it.

faq.q: Do you deliver, install and service in Canada?
faq.a: Yes — every press brake is shipped to Mississauga, unloaded, levelled, commissioned and the operators trained by NovoTech; Dener Canada and NovoTech stock the parts here. Every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, 600 V standard (208 / 240 / 480 V on request), a 1-year warranty and remote diagnostics through the control.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
